Why WADL needs it: Primary key for every authorization object
Coding convention to confirm: Is the ID stable across baseline re-issues, or regenerated?

Candidate P6 source: Activity code, UDF, or embedded in WBS path
Coding convention to confirm: THE critical question. Is compartment a code, a UDF, or parsed out of the activity name? Is it deck-frame-side-usage, and is it consistently formatted?
Fallback if absent: Manual mapping table for the pilot scope, maintained by the planner. Do NOT parse free text in production.

Coding convention to confirm: Are resources modelled per trade, per shop, or per crew? Are they loaded on every activity or only on cost-significant ones?
Fallback if absent: Derive from activity code prefix; confirm the prefix convention.

Coding convention to confirm: Are hours loaded at baseline or only after resource levelling?
Fallback if absent: Use planned duration x crew size; flag as derived.

Coding convention to confirm: Are these the dates the yard actually works to, or is a separate short-interval schedule the real one?
Fallback if absent: If a separate SIS exists, ingest THAT and treat P6 as the milestone frame.

Why WADL needs it: Gate markers on the sequence board
Coding convention to confirm: How are undock, launch, fast cruise, sea trials, delivery coded? Is there a controlled milestone list?
Fallback if absent: Manual milestone list for the pilot.

Coding convention to confirm: What do the WBS levels actually mean? Manual says one thing; practice usually differs. Which level is zone, which is system, which is work package?
Fallback if absent: Ask for the WBS dictionary AND a sample export; reconcile the two.

Coding convention to confirm: Are relationships real logic, or are constraints used to force dates? Count the hard constraints — they hide logic.
Fallback if absent: Report constraint density as a data-quality metric.

Why WADL needs it: Ties the plan to the authorization object
Coding convention to confirm: Is there a WO number on the activity, or does the link live only in the MIS?
Fallback if absent: Join through the MIS on activity ID.

Coding convention to confirm: One project per hull, or multiple hulls per project?
Is a docking a project, or a WBS branch?
Is percent complete physical, duration-based, or units-based? They give different answers.
Fallback if absent: Use status only; treat percent complete as advisory.

Coding convention to confirm: Almost certainly not modelled. Ask how deferred work is actually tracked today.
Fallback if absent: Capture in WADL at close-out; do not expect P6 to carry it.

Coding convention to confirm: Growth is usually tracked outside P6. Find where.
Is work type coded at all, or inferred from the activity name?
Fallback if absent: Classify at ingest from a keyword map; require planner confirmation.
